preconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case's integer N must satisfy 3 ≤ N ≤ 10³.
The number of test cases T must satisfy 1 ≤ T ≤ 10³.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, output exactly one line of space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == int(line.strip()) for line, stdout in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1:], [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output array A has length exactly N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.split()) for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, every element in A satisfies 1 ≤ Aᵢ ≤ 10¹⁸.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in subsequence) and math.gcd(*[int(x) for x in subsequence]) == i for subsequence in combinations(stdout.split(), k) for k in range(2, int(line.strip()) + 1)) for i in range(1, int(line.strip()) + 1) for line, stdout in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1:], [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, for every 1 ≤ i ≤ N, there exists a subsequence of A of length ≥ 2 whose GCD is exactly i.
